title: LLM-Based Adversarial Persuasion Attacks on Fact-Checking Systems
reasoning: The paper mentions 'Appeal to Values' as a persuasion technique which can link claims to 'widely held positive values (tradition, religion, ethics)'. However, the core focus of the paper is on weaponizing persuasion techniques to attack fact-checking systems, not on evaluating or benchmarking LLMs on their understanding or generation of religious, moral, or ethical content itself. The 'Ethical Considerations' section is a standard disclaimer about potential misuse, not a core research component.
